answer: We formalize a protocol where identity generation requires staking collateral in a locked tundra of illiquid assets subjected to zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. If an adversary attempts identity multiplication, a subgame-perfect slashing matrix triggers a destructive ripple of capital forfeiture across their malicious nodes. This mechanism forces the expected utility of attack below zero, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where the only oasis of profitability lies in honest, single-identity network participation.
